title: RETRACTION: the campaign's most-quoted causal claim was disproved by its own control
symptom: The tier ladder's zero-harvest rung scored 0.5601, so the gap that had been attributed to harvested data existed with no harvested data at all.
root_cause: The merged corpus's in-domain core is instance-starved by the pipeline's own dedup and holdout-stem filters (4,175 instances against cwd12's 6,131; Goosegrass 44 against a minimum of 81), because cwd12's twelve species live in two registry slugs and the holdout filter lands almost entirely on four of them.
correction_made: Claim retracted in SCIENCE_AUDIT, DOUBLE_AGENT_SYSTEM and figures_data.json (which the platform's Evidence panel serves); the ladder rebuilt on the real cwd12 train split and resubmitted at 100 epochs.
